FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 361
Committee: Transportation, Utilities and Sponsor: Representative Bedsole
Infrastructure
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/02/2024
House Bill 361 as introduced would codify the current commercial driver license fee schedule.
This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Page 1

FN-5NKB36M-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 361
Committee: Transportation, Utilities and Sponsor: Representative Bedsole
Infrastructure
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/16/2024
REVISED
House Bill 361 as reported by the committee on Transportation, Utilities, and Infrastructure
would codify the existing commercial driver license fee schedule and repeal certain fines and
safety certification requirements to be in compliance with federal law. If not enacted by
September 30, 2024, the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency (ALEA) is subject to having an
estimated $9 million in annual federal Motor Carrier Safety Assistance Program funding
withheld for noncompliance. This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Page 1
